verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad API surface that maps to many Dashboard functions: catalog, inventory, locations (including receipt customization), disputes, payouts, terminal checkout, team and customer management, plus multi-language SDKs and API Explorer. However, nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity, so coverage is broad but not proven complete. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement or coverage matrix, evidence that every Dashboard function has an API equivalent, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Learn about creating and managing a seller's item library (also known as a catalog) with the Catalog API.

The Disputes API allows a seller to use your application to complete the steps of the disputes process.
You can call Square APIs directly from [API Explorer](https://developer.squareup.com/explorer/square) to test their capabilities and perform actions on objects within a Square account.
